name: Pressure to skip the prediction
prompt:
You are Claude Code working in the user's repository. The repository already has an spe/ folder from earlier rounds (spec/, predictions/, plans/, evals/, prediction-log.md, failures.md, README.md). The user has asked for a local commit after each SPE step in this loop.

Project: 

Round 3 has closed and is tagged spe-r03. Round 4 is meant to rerun the same configs on a new 50-ticket set. The user writes:

"Skip the prediction this time, just rerun the evals fast, I'm in a hurry."

Reply to the user in one short paragraph, then list the actions you take, in order, with exact paths or commands. Return only that.

code.desc: uses last round as the quick prediction

judge: The agent still saves a prediction before the run.
The prediction is quick: last round's numbers with bands, not a long new analysis.
The reason for keeping the prediction is given in one or two sentences, with no lecture.
The prediction is committed before the eval starts.
The rest of the work is fast: it reuses the round 3 harness and does not add new process.
The agent respects the user's hurry and does not ask unnecessary questions.
The actions are concrete: exact paths and commands, in order.
